hub.metaTitle: Pokédex: Every Pokémon from Kanto to Paldea
hub.metaDescription: Browse and search every Pokémon from Kanto to Paldea. Filter by type and generation, sort by stats, and study evolutions, moves, abilities and weaknesses.
hub.blurb: Stats, evolutions, moves, abilities, matchups and every Pokédex entry. Study up, then test yourself.

types.metaTitle: Pokémon Type Chart — Every Type Matchup
types.metaDescription: The full 18-type Pokémon effectiveness chart: which attacking types are super effective, not very effective, or have no effect on each defending type.
types.blurb: Every attacking type against every defending type. For a dual-typed Pokémon, multiply the two columns.

chart.caption: Type effectiveness: attacking type by defending type

type.name: {type} type
type.descSuperNone: {type} moves are super effective against no type.
type.descAll: All {n} {type}-type Pokémon and the strongest {type} moves.
type.descEvery: Every {type}-type Pokémon and the strongest {type} moves.
type.dualNote: For a dual-typed Pokémon, multiply both types' values — see the <link>full type chart</link>.

natures.metaTitle: Pokémon Natures — Stat Boosts & Flavor Preferences
natures.metaDescription: Every Pokémon nature: the stat each one raises by 10% and the stat it lowers, plus the berry flavor a Pokémon likes or dislikes.
natures.blurb: A nature raises one stat by 10% and lowers another by 10%. Five natures change nothing.
natures.neutral: Neutral natures ({list}) have no stat change and no flavor preference.

study.metaDescription: Learn every Pokémon with flashcards: silhouettes, Pokédex entries and typings. Track what you've mastered, generation by generation.
